entries.headline: NORSE44 E-3 Sentry sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported NORSE44, an E-3 Sentry with hex code AE11EF, over Idaho. The sighting was credited to lauraprietosanchez2240 and the photo to Cayden Smith – Arizona Aviation via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: EAM header code reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble with code 4SF7LS.

entries.headline: Sirik IRGC launcher strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Ilia Hashemi report that an IRGC missile launcher in the hills of Sirik was targeted in a drone strike. The item was credited to weslester6474.

entries.headline: U.S. and East Asia military-flight activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported unusually active U.S. military transport and surveillance aircraft over the continental United States, with a separate spike in military flights near Korea and Japan.

entries.headline: Kyiv ballistic-missile attack reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that Russia launched a missile attack on Kyiv using more than 10 ballistic missiles, reportedly including Iskander-M, Zircon and S-400 systems.

entries.headline: U.S. strike on anti-ship missile launcher reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed initial reports that a U.S. strike targeted an anti-ship cruise-missile launcher. The item was credited to weslester6474.

entries.headline: Shaybah oil-field drone report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report quoting Saudi Arabia’s Energy Ministry that a drone attempted to target the Shaybah oil field, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Hormuz explosion and vessel-hailing report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a 1900 GTM report of an explosion around Hormuz and U.S. Navy hails to multiple vessels, including tanker AURA over an alleged illegal ship-to-ship transfer. The item was credited to weslester6474.

entries.headline: Fars News Agency Sirik explosions report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Iran Fars News Agency report that several explosions were heard in Sirik, Iran, with the cause unknown. The item was credited to weslester6474.

entries.headline: U.S. transport, surveillance and bomber activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four U.S. Air Force transport aircraft, a surveillance aircraft and a bomber airborne over the United States following four coded radio broadcasts earlier that day.

entries.headline: VEGAS11 Gray Eagle sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported VEGAS11, identified in the post as an Army General Atomics NQ-1C Gray Eagle with hex code AE5C14. The sighting was credited to timharkness9152.

entries.headline: U.S. command, bomber and radar aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple high-level U.S. military aircraft airborne over the continental United States, including a nuclear-command aircraft, surveillance aircraft, bomber and airborne-radar aircraft.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: N333QS North Las Vegas arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a one-take replay of N333QS, a Phenom 300, flying from Van Nuys to North Las Vegas and continuing from the valley to touchdown and back.

entries.headline: Harry Reid ramp aircraft counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 38 aircraft on one Harry Reid ramp and 26 on another on Wednesday morning during NBAA-BACE, shown in four frames from the valley to the ramp.

entries.headline: KLAS show-week ramp tour shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a continuous tour of the KLAS ramp, noting that show-week ground activity becomes difficult after aircraft land.

entries.headline: Las Vegas Strip helicopter replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 120-times-speed replay of Tuesday evening helicopter tours operating from Harry Reid International Airport, along the Las Vegas Strip and back.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of NBAA-BACE day-one peak traffic covering KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU, followed by a whole-valley view.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE Tuesday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas valley traffic down 9% and business-jet traffic down 19% on Tuesday, October 20, compared with Monday, based on SkyGlass MCP data.

entries.headline: Las Vegas valley traffic peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of the previous day’s peak traffic across four Las Vegas-area airfields.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one traffic view shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass presented a day-one NBAA-BACE live view covering four Las Vegas-area airfields, with valley-wide views and closer views of KLAS and KHND.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE traffic after-action report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Las Vegas valley traffic on 19 October was down 4% while business-jet activity held steady. The post credited the data to the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: NetJets Citation Latitude arrival at KHND shown
entries.summary: SkyGlass showed NetJets Citation Latitude N910QS arriving from Denver Centennial and parking on the ramp at KHND, with ramp movements marked across the sequence.

entries.headline: BACE ramp boards launched for four Las Vegas fields
entries.summary: SkyGlass announced live ramp boards for KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU during BACE show week.

entries.headline: N200SG field view and airframe brief shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a field view and an Airframe Intelligence Brief for Falcon 50 N200SG.
